boolean_surfaces.name: Boolean Surfaces: CSG as Composition
boolean_surfaces.v1_4_note: Reactivated as a spine sequence (order 12.7). Constructive Solid Geometry — union, intersection, difference of primitives — as the algebra of composed solid form. Sits between isosurfaces and softbodies.
boolean_surfaces.truth: Composition is not addition. Boolean ops give us a lawful way to compose solids: A∪B, A∩B, A−B. Every architectural cavity is a difference; every joint is an intersection.
boolean_surfaces.qfep_connection: Boolean operations are the smallest non-trivial calculus on solids. Pure F: deterministic composition without entropy term. Architectural cavity = difference; joint = intersection.
content: Boolean_Union: A ∪ B — the union operator made solid
Boolean_Intersection: A ∩ B — the overlap as lens
Boolean_Difference: A − B — the cavity-making operator
Boolean_Compose_Workbench: all three operators side by side; the csg-compose affordance home
Boolean_Architecture_Cavity: a habitable wall built by subtraction
